_comment: Cross-platform modern default set. These GGUF tags run on Windows, macOS and Linux and cover current-generation tool-calling / reasoning models from 4B to 30B. For Apple Silicon MLX builds use --config ollama-bench-mac-mlx.json. Larger local models (e.g. nemotron-3-nano:30b, llama3.3:70b) can be benchmarked ad hoc with --models.
